$comment: Machine-readable dispatch table for the orchestrator. The Agent Skills spec has no skill-calls-skill primitive, so composition is: read ../<path>/SKILL.md and follow it against the shared evidence bundle. Order is listed order; the mechanism sequence is meaningful (an earlier-stage failure makes later stages moot) but the analyses themselves are independent and may run in parallel.

stages.question: What is literally on this site?
stages.skip_when: never — every other stage depends on its output
stages.notes: The only skill permitted to touch the network. Extracts, never judges.

stages.question: Can a machine get in?
stages.notes: Runs first conceptually: if the crawler cannot get in, every later finding is downstream of that one cause.

stages.question: Can a machine read what is there?
stages.notes: READ-001 (content absent from raw HTML) is a root cause that supersedes most PARSE and QUOTE findings on the same pages.

stages.question: Can a machine parse specific facts out?
stages.notes: Required-property expectations are gated by site_profile; see references/schema-requirements.md in that skill.

stages.question: Can a machine lift a clear, self-contained fact?
stages.notes: Highest proportion of model-judged checks in the marketplace. The model-judged ceiling in gate 3 applies with full force here.

stages.question: Will a machine believe and repeat the fact?
stages.requires_tool: web search or fetch, for off-site corroboration only
stages.skip_when: skip_offsite is set, or no search/fetch tool is available — in that case run the on-site freshness checks only and record the skipped check_ids in coverage.checks_skipped
stages.notes: The only analysis skill with an optional off-site component. On-site freshness checks always run.

stages.question: Does the visitor who arrives stay?
stages.skip_when: never — this is the entire engagement half of the report and must always appear

supersession_rules.rationale: If the main content is absent from the raw HTML, the absence of structured data and quotable facts on that page is a symptom of one root cause, not four independent defects.
If retrieval agents are disallowed outright, sitemap quality and CDN behaviour cannot matter until that is fixed.
A noindexed page's markup gaps are moot while the page is excluded from indexes.
A consent wall serving no content pre-consent explains the empty body, the unquotable chunks, and the missing orientation simultaneously.
